title: 5th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/5/1/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominations for Non-Resident Ambassadors to foreign countries (Constitution Article 115(d), Foreign Service Act, Law No. 20/2021, Article 14) are sent to the relevant standing committee; the countries are not named in the agenda text.

Independent Institutions Committee report on the President's submission to appoint the President and Vice President of the Elections Commission (Elections Commission Act, Law No. 8/2008, Article 7(b)).

Independent Institutions Committee report on the President's submission to appoint the Vice President of the Anti-Corruption Commission (Anti-Corruption Commission Act, Law No. 13/2008, Article 7(b)).
Government Oversight Committee report on the President's request for Parliament's consent, under Constitution Article 129, for Thoriq Ibrahim (G. Noomaraahiya) as Minister of Tourism and Environment.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to forward new ambassador nominations to committee and vote on committee reports approving Elections Commission and Anti-Corruption Commission leadership and the new Tourism and Environment Minister.
